responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL branch-target-register load optimization pass. Running after reload on targets that expose a branch_target_register_class hook, it analyzes definitions and uses of branch target registers across the CFG, builds def-use webs and approximate live ranges, and tries to migrate target-load instructions earlier or into less frequently executed blocks so branch targets are available sooner and loop or hot-path overhead is reduced. It owns the dataflow, dominance, cost ordering, and code-motion logic for this specialized late backend optimization, and defines the two rtl_opt_pass entry points that invoke it.
